description_en: Queries whether the features of the purchased Security Center modules are enabled or configured
description_zh: 查询已购买的云安全中心产品模块功能是否开启或配置生效
name: GetModuleConfigStatus

parameters.help_en: The list of product modules to query
parameters.name: module_names

ModuleConfigResults.description_en: The list of product check results

items.description_en: The check result of a single product module
items.description_zh: 单个产品模块检查结果

ModuleName.description_en:
The name of the product module. Valid values:

Ransom: The anti-ransomware policy is enabled.

WebLock: The web tamper-proofing feature is enabled.

Rasp: Application Protection settings are created.

Image: The scan scope for container images is configured.

Virus: The periodic virus scan policy is enabled
ModuleName.description_zh:
产品模块名称。取值：
Ransom：开启防勒索策略

WebLock：开启网页防篡改功能

Rasp：已创建应用防护配置

Image：已配置容器镜像扫描范围

Virus：开启周期病毒扫描策略

Pass.description_en:
Indicates whether the product passes the status check. Valid values:

true: The check is passed. The feature is enabled or configured.

false: The check is failed. The feature is not enabled or configured
Pass.description_zh:
产品是否通过状态检查。取值：

true：通过检查，已开启或已配置

false：未通过检查，未开启或未配置

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. This is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的 ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
